guard.dictionary_scope: subset of observed queries; full-dictionary replay not performed
limitations: Archive hash must be obtained from trusted provenance; no proof OCR text is true.
Direct crop pixel correspondence independently checked locally, not enforced by generic guard.
Existing ROI and candidate grammar remain fitted; no independent accuracy measurement.

holdout.selection: User selects recording of a different battle; different file hash alone does not establish independence.
holdout.report: One uniquely named review ZIP; contains six frames and raw OCR results. No video or private transcripts published to GitHub.
holdout.decision: Freeze v6-v9 for next pilot; no further tuning on current examples. Assess new frames before modifying parser; report misses and untested classes separately.
